title: The Berry in Your Breakfast Could Be Helping Your Heart, According to New Research - Food & Wine
summary: Your morning handful of blueberries may be doing more for your heart than you realized. New research found that anthocyanin-rich foods like blueberries, cherries, and red cabbage are linked to a lower risk of heart disease and type 2 diabetes. The best part? You don’t need to eat very much to potentially reap the benefits.
